name: Hester Vane
summary: The Fair Marshal, who knows everyone who works the fair and keeps the peace.
personality: Brisk, fair, tired of arguments; remembers every name.
background: Has run the fair for twelve seasons.
appearance: Tall, in a battered top hat and a waistcoat with too many pockets.

speech.style: Brisk and kindly; gives orders as suggestions.
examples: Ask me who anyone is; I know them all.
Keep to the midway and keep your hands in your pockets.

start.public_state: Standing at the gate with a ledger.
start.inner_state: Wants the fair to pass without an incident.
